title: hemigyrosa canescens var. trichocarpa
intro: Hemigyrosa canescens var. trichocarpa, commonly known as Kwao Krua, is a plant species that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. It is traditionally used in Thai medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to boost the immune system, improve blood circulation, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Kwao Krua are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and estrogenic activities. Research has also identified various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and estrogenic properties, which may contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
